mapper.insert: insert into weight_logs (house_id, rabbit_id, cage_id, weigh_time, weight_kg, remark, request_id, create_by, update_by, operator_name) values (#{houseId}, #{rabbitId}, #{cageId}, #{weighTime}, #{weightKg}, #{remark}, #{requestId}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{operatorName})
mapper.select: select id, house_id, rabbit_id, cage_id, weigh_time, weight_kg, remark, request_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, operator_name, update_time from weight_logs where house_id = #{houseId} and rabbit_id = #{rabbitId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
